A study37 of 5 different assay methods, including radio-im- munoassay, HPLC, and FPIA, found that when measuring C0, this would indeed be the case, but that with C2 monitoring, dif- ferences in the results from the various assay methods were not statistically significant, and were unlikely to be of clinical signif- icance. Different proportions of parent ciclosporin and metabo- lites were thought to be the reason for this disparity at the two time points.
